meta.name: offensive-active-directory
meta.description: Active Directory attack methodology for internal network red team engagements. Covers reconnaissance (BloodHound, PowerView, ADExplorer), credential abuse (Kerberoasting, ASREProasting, NTLM relay, LLMNR/NBT-NS poisoning), privilege escalation (ACL abuse, GPO abuse, unconstrained/constrained delegation), lateral movement (Pass-the-Hash, Pass-the-Ticket, Overpass-the-Hash, WMI/WinRM/PsExec), persistence (Golden/Silver/Diamond Tickets, DCSync, DCShadow, AdminSDHolder, Skeleton Key), forest trust attacks, ADCS abuse (ESC1-ESC15), and modern MDI/Defender for Identity evasion. Use when assessing on-prem AD, hybrid AD/Entra ID environments, or ADCS deployments.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照红队渗透流程，指导你完成 Active Directory 内网攻击，包括侦察、凭据窃取、权限提升、横向移动、持久化、域信任攻击、ADCS 滥用以及绕过 MDI/Defender for Identity 检测。
howto.when: 当你需要评估本地 AD、混合 AD/Entra ID 环境或 ADCS 部署的安全性时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 BloodHound 枚举域内所有用户和计算机。
对域控执行 DCSync 攻击，获取 krbtgt 哈希。
检查 ADCS 是否存在 ESC1 漏洞。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through Active Directory internal network red team operations, including reconnaissance, credential harvesting, privilege escalation, lateral movement, persistence, forest trust attacks, ADCS abuse, and evasion of MDI/Defender for Identity.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to assess on-prem AD, hybrid AD/Entra ID environments, or ADCS deployments.

say_en.text: Enumerate all domain users and computers with BloodHound.

say_en.text: Perform DCSync against the domain controller to get krbtgt hash.
